description:
Cast a copy of Molten Tide from exile by paying {R}, unpreparing Pyre Rhymer.
Displacer Kitten and Runaway Steam-Kin both trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Pyre Rhymer.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the spell from Step 1.
Repeat twice.
Remove three +1/+1 counters from Runaway Steam-Kin, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
